remarks: Welcome to 87 Ridge Park Ave! This charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath home offers 1,180 square feet of living space with the potential to easily convert back into a 4-bedroom layout. Step inside to find natural woodwork throughout and a functional first-floor layout featuring a spacious living room, formal dining room, kitchen with included appliances, and a full bathroom. The generously sized first-floor bedroom was originally two separate bedrooms and could easily be converted back to accommodate your needs. Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms and convenient walk-in attic storage. The home also features a full basement with a washer and dryer that are included in the sale. Central air conditioning, installed in 2022, keeps the home comfortable throughout those warm Buffalo summers. Enjoy your morning coffee on the covered front porch or relax out back on the two-level deck, featuring a covered section with direct access to the first-floor bedroom. The fully fenced, low-maintenance backyard is complemented by a two-car garage with remote opener and a well-maintained concrete driveway. Recent improvements include newer vinyl windows, central air conditioning installed in 2022, and updated flooring in the kitchen, hallway, and bathroom in 2024. Located in the Cheektowaga School District, this home offers a great combination of character, functionality, and flexibility. Don't miss your opportunity to make it yours! Open house: Thursday October 22nd from 5pm-7pm.
